title: A fake WhatsApp clone is showing up before the real version on the Play Store
summary: Their listing for the WhatsApp impostor has the same icon, screenshots, and text as the real version, but the real WhatsApp has over 10 billion downloads, an “editor’s choice” badge, and over 246 million reviews.
